Subject: Outstanding invoice INV-88821 — confirm payment path and VAT docs

Hi Elena,

Hope you're well — quick follow on INV-88821 for Lumos (PO 78215). The invoice for $48,300 USD was due 2027-05-15 and is still open on our side. I attached a copy of the invoice for reference (INV-88821.pdf).

To avoid any delay on your end, could you confirm which payment route AP prefers:
- ACH to our US account
- Wire (we'll send SWIFT/IBAN details)
- Virtual card (we can issue immediately, small processing fee)

Also, because Lumos is VAT-registered in the UK, please confirm whether you need a VAT-compliant invoice (we can reissue a VAT-format invoice) and any specific billing reference your team requires.

Next steps: please reply with the payment method and whether you need the VAT invoice; we can prioritize wire details or issue a virtual card today.

Thanks — appreciate the quick reply.

—
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

> Hi Elena,
> 
> Hope you're well — quick follow on INV-88821 for Lumos (PO 78215). The invoice for $48,300 USD was due 2027-05-15 and is still open on our side. I attached a copy of the invoice for reference (INV-88821.pdf).

Thanks, Kimberly. Sorry about the delay — we had a bank rotation in AP and our virtual card batch for May failed yesterday.

We can do a wire but I need the following before treasury will release funds: 1) a VAT-compliant invoice showing Lumos Health's VAT ID, 2) confirmation of Redwood's VAT status (UK/EU sales VAT handling) or an EU reverse-charge note if applicable, and 3) an IBAN/SWIFT instruction. If you can get the VAT-format invoice and wire details to me today, treasury will try to queue payment for 26 May.

PO: 78215
Requested payment date: 2027-05-26
Contact in AP: Sara O'Neill <ap@lumoshealth.co.uk>

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Treasury — Lumos Health

Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice INV-88821 — confirm payment path and VAT docs

Elena — thanks for the quick note and for the heads up on the payment date.

I've attached: 1) a VAT-compliant version of INV-88821 (INV-88821-VAT.pdf) that includes Lumos Health's VAT ID and our VAT reference; and 2) our wire instructions (wire_instructions.pdf). Wire details include IBAN and SWIFT for our UK clearing partner to reduce FX friction.

If it helps treasury move faster, we can also:
- Issue a virtual card for the payment (same-day authorization) — we pass a 2% processing fee to cover card acceptance; or
- Accept a partial payment (30%) to take the account out of past-due status while you complete the wire.

Marissa, looping you and Ben to flag expected incoming wire on 2027-05-26 and the attached VAT invoice. Please monitor banking and confirm when funds post.

Elena — can you confirm which option you prefer (wire + VAT invoice, virtual card, or partial wire)? Once we have confirmation I'll mark the deal in HubSpot as 'payment incoming'.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: INV-88821-VAT.pdf (VAT-format invoice, PDF, 1 page); wire_instructions.pdf (bank details, PDF, 1 page)
